user_story: As a user, I want to update multiple fields of a task in a single request so that I can edit efficiently.

positive.title: Update all fields of a task with valid data
steps: Update task title, description, due date, and priority
positive.expected_result: Task details are updated successfully and changes are visible in the task list

positive.title: Update a single field of a task
positive.expected_result: Task title is updated successfully and change is visible in the task list

negative.title: Attempt to update task with invalid date
steps: Update task with an invalid date format
negative.expected_result: Error message shown: 'Invalid date format'; task details remain unchanged

negative.title: Attempt to update task with empty mandatory fields
negative.expected_result: Validation error: 'Task title is required'; task details remain unchanged

edge.title: Update task with maximum length fields
steps: Update task title and description with maximum allowed characters
edge.expected_result: Task is updated successfully, and all changes are reflected in the task list and do not exceed maximum length constraints

edge.title: Simultaneous multiple updates to the same task from different sessions
steps: Open the task in two different browser sessions
In the first session, update the task title
In the second session, update the task description
edge.expected_result: The system handles the updates correctly with no data conflicts, and the task reflects the last consistent update
